fullContentHtml:
NTA CSIR UGC NET June E Certificate 2026 – Full Details

Short Details : National Testing Agency (NTA-CSIR UGC NET) has released the E Certificate for the CSIR UGC NET June 2026 Examination on the official website of the NTA in this week. The online application process for NTA CSIR UGC NET June online Form 2026 were accepted from 27 May 2026 to 19 June 2026. The Exam was conducted on 17,18 July 2026. Candidates who appeared in this examination can download their NTA CSIR UGC NET June E Certificate 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 27 May 2026
  • Last Date : 19 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 20 June 2026
  • Correction Date : 22-23 June 2026
  • Exam Date : 17, 18 July 2026
  • Exam City Intimation : 08 July 2026
  • Admit Card : 13 July 2026
  • Answer Key : 16 August 2026
  • Final Answer Key : 29 August 2026
  • Result : 29 August 2026
  • Score Card : 11 September 2026
  • E Certificate : 26 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General : Rs. 1150/-
  • EWS, OBC NCL : Rs. 600/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 325/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

What is NTA CSIR UGC NET June E Certificate 2026?

NTA CSIR UGC NET June E Certificate 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
